name.en: Delhi State Crop Damage Compensation Scheme (Natural Calamity / Unseasonal Rain)

bilingual_title.en: Delhi State Crop Damage Compensation Scheme (Natural Calamity / Unseasonal Rain)

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Damaged crops on agricultural land within NCT of Delhi; Haryana/UP use e-Kshatipurti/Rahat.

benefit.summary_hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा, ओलावृष्टि, बाढ़ या बेमौसम बारिश से फसल नुकसान पर दिल्ली किसानों को प्रति एकड़ मुआवजा।
benefit.summary_en: Compensation per hectare/acre for verified crop loss due to floods, hailstorm, or unseasonal rain in Delhi [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].

benefit_summary.en: Compensation per hectare/acre for verified crop loss due to floods, hailstorm, or unseasonal rain in Delhi [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].
benefit_summary.hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा, ओलावृष्टि, बाढ़ या बेमौसम बारिश से फसल नुकसान पर दिल्ली किसानों को प्रति एकड़ मुआवजा।

application_steps.offline: Report crop loss to Tehsil / Patwari / SDM Office / CFC.

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
